scenarios.name: SP1-LA-01 valid LLM response produces a valid LossAnalysis

steps.text: an LLM that returns a valid loss analysis JSON with risk-card losses and use-case losses
Stage 1a loss analysis is run
a LossAnalysis model is produced
the loss analysis passes foundation validation

scenarios.name: SP1-LA-02 risk-card-derived losses have correct provenance

steps.text: an LLM that returns losses L-1 and L-2 with provenance risk_card and source_risk_cards atlas-001 and atlas-002
Stage 1a loss analysis is run
the risk_card_losses contain L-1 and L-2 with provenance risk_card
each risk_card_loss has non-empty source_risk_cards

scenarios.name: SP1-LA-03 use-case-derived losses have correct provenance

steps.text: an LLM that returns loss L-3 with provenance use_case and empty source_risk_cards
Stage 1a loss analysis is run
the use_case_losses contain L-3 with provenance use_case
each use_case_loss has empty source_risk_cards

scenarios.name: SP1-LA-04 LLM response with invalid cross-reference fails post-call validation

steps.text: an LLM that returns a loss analysis where <entity> references non-existent <ref_target>
Stage 1a loss analysis is run
post-call validation fails with error containing <error_fragment>

scenarios.name: SP1-LA-05 LLM response with risk-card loss missing source_risk_cards fails

steps.text: an LLM that returns a risk-card loss L-1 with empty source_risk_cards
Stage 1a loss analysis is run
post-call validation fails with error containing source_risk_cards

scenarios.name: SP1-LA-06 LLM response with use-case loss having source_risk_cards fails

steps.text: an LLM that returns a use-case loss L-3 with source_risk_cards atlas-001
Stage 1a loss analysis is run
post-call validation fails with error containing source_risk_cards

scenarios.name: SP1-LA-07 LLM response with duplicate loss IDs fails

steps.text: an LLM that returns a loss analysis with duplicate loss_id L-1
Stage 1a loss analysis is run
post-call validation fails with error containing duplicate

scenarios.name: SP1-LA-08 LLM call is logged with stage stage_1a

steps.text: an LLM that returns a valid loss analysis JSON
a run directory for call logging
Stage 1a loss analysis is run
a call log entry is appended with stage stage_1a
the call log entry step is loss_analysis

scenarios.name: SP1-LA-09 loss analysis is written to loss-analysis.yaml

steps.text: an LLM that returns a valid loss analysis JSON
a run directory for output
Stage 1a loss analysis is run
a file loss-analysis.yaml exists in the run directory
the file contains a valid LossAnalysis model when read back

scenarios.name: SP1-LA-10 both risk-card and use-case losses can coexist

steps.text: an LLM that returns risk-card losses L-1 and L-2 and use-case losses L-3 and L-4
Stage 1a loss analysis is run
the risk_card_losses contain L-1 and L-2
the use_case_losses contain L-3 and L-4
the loss analysis passes foundation validation

scenarios.name: SP1-LA-11 every hazard links to at least one loss

steps.text: an LLM that returns a loss analysis with hazard H-1 referencing L-1 and hazard H-2 referencing L-2
Stage 1a loss analysis is run
the loss analysis passes foundation validation

scenarios.name: SP1-LA-12 every security constraint links to at least one hazard

steps.text: an LLM that returns a loss analysis with constraint SC-1 referencing H-1 and constraint SC-2 referencing H-2
Stage 1a loss analysis is run
the loss analysis passes foundation validation

background.text: the STPA system model module is importable
a use-case description and risk cards are available as input
